LEVEL_12
Greetings, Mello.
Ahem... allow me to introduce myself.
I am a powerful Wizard, and I am on a Quest.  A very specific Wizard Quest.
The image you see before you is not actually me. It is an illusion I created.
I cannot enter this world, because it doesn't actually exist.
It is a false reality meant to imprison you.
I will help you escape.
That is all I can say for now.  Good luck.
LEVEL_14
Hi again.
I've placed some platforms to help you across these spikes.
Don't stand on them for too long, or they will break.
Sorry, my magic doesn't work very well here.
LEVEL_21
You have to move fast.  They didn't expect you to make it this far.
They're sending reinforcements.
LEVEL_26
Chickens are deadly, but if you jump on their heads, you can bounce to high places.
Be careful!
LEVEL_31
You're probably wondering why you're even here.
It's because you are special, Mello.  And they know it.
They fear the potential you have.
So they try to keep you contained, in this 'inescapable' prison.
But you've almost escaped.  Again.
That alone proves that you are just as special as they fear you are.
When you're out, meet me in the Kingdom of Nor.
Then, we'll talk face to face, with no chance of them hearing us.
LEVEL_41
You've almost escaped.
Continue to be strong, and you can't fail.
LEVEL_50
This is your final challenge, Mello.
You've come so far; I know you can escape.
See you soon.
LEVEL_51
It's good to finally see you, Mello.
You have faced many hardships to get here, to the Kingdom of Nor.
I suppose you want answers now.  About who trapped you, and why.
Don't worry, I shall explain everything.

pJcGm2hfUO6l9Fr4T|}M: This time, it won't let Mello escape.

aajiG,[/,Ki^}0(U1*,i: Long ago, there was a savage alien civilization called the Zeirix.
They lived in tunnels beneath the surface of their home planet.
Until one fateful night, when the Zeirix discovered a terrible power.
The power to travel to other Games.
I suppose you don't know what a Game is.
A Game is a world.  There are millions of them.
The Zeirix are using their power to invade other Games, and rule over the inhabitants.
This Game, the Kingdom of Nor, is their most recent victim.
Mello... it has been prophesied that you will be the one to defeat the Zeirix.
That is why they trapped you in this "inescapable" prison.
Only you can embark on this quest, but I will help you in any way I can.
You will do great things, Mello.
Together, we will defeat them all.
